faqs.question: Is Galgotias University a public or private university?
faqs.answer: Galgotias University is a private university. The university is recognised by the UGC and approved by the PCI,  BCI,  INC,  COA,  NCTE, and NCHM. The university is accredited by the NAAC A+ Grade.

faqs.question: Are Galgotias University admissions open?
faqs.answer: Yes, Galgotias University admission 2026 is open. The university accepts admission through the online application. Interesred students can apply directly through the official page. Aspiring students must qualify the eligibility criteria set by the institute.

faqs.question: Is it worth pursuing BBA at Galgotias University?
faqs.answer:
Galgotias University offers BBA courses in top specialisations of the field, which is inclusive of Aviation Management, Business Analytics, Tourism & Travel Management, etc. Moreover, students can also pursue four-year courses in BBA (Hons in Research) programmes. The university offers impressive scholarships to students to meritorious students and 100% tuition fee waivers are offered to the toppers of all the Board/University.
Recently, Galgotias University has been ranked 12 by TIMES for its BBA course. As per the recent placement records, the average package was recorded at 5.4 LPA. Overall, the university can be a decent choice to pursue BBA course.

admission_process.title: Symbiosis Institute of Design Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Symbiosis Institute of Design Pune admissions are entrance-based. The institute conducts the Symbiosis Entrance Exam for Design (SEED) for admission.Symbiosis Institute of Designoffers a four-year BDes course at the UG level. The BDes degree is awarded bySymbiosis International University (SIU), Pune.
Check below the eligibility and selection criteria for the SID BDes course:
Eligibility:Class 12 or equivalent or Class 10 along with three-year diploma with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST)
Aspirants appearing for final year exam can also apply

The institute offers BDes for a duration of four years at the UG level.Symbiosis International University (SIU), Puneawards the BDes degree to the candidates who have completed the course.Symbiosis Institute of Designoffers BDes in four major disciplines which are further available in various specialisations. Find below the SID Fees and seat intake:

Step 1:The Symbiosis Entrance Exam for Design (SEED) is now available online. The results of SEED will be posted on the SID website according to the schedule. If a candidate passes SEED, they can proceed to SID's Portfolio Review and Personal Interaction (PRPI). Admission shortlisting will be based on the chosen specialization during online registration.
Step 2:Make sure to upload your portfolio to the portal before the PRPI.

faqs.question: Is Symbiosis Institute of Design approved?
faqs.answer: Yes,Symbiosis Institute of Designis approved by (UGC) and accredited with A Grade by NAAC. All its courses are approved by UGC (University Grants Commission). To getadmissionto this UGC (University Grants Commission) approved college, candidates will have to pass the entrance exams. Getting a good score in the entrance exam is necessary as the competition is quite high and the students applying for this college are many. For more information pleaseclick here.

faqs.question: Is Symbiosis Institute of Design a good college for Design?
faqs.answer: Yes,Symbiosis Institute of Designis a good design college which is ranked as second Best Private Fashion Design College by the India Today & Outlook I-Care Rankings 2022. To get admission to this college, candidates must have passed SEED. For passing SEED, candidates must follow theSEED preparation strategy, fill out theexam centrecarefully, and timely fill out theSEED application form. Seats are limited so apply early as soon as possible.

faqs.question: Is SEED compulsory for admission to BDes programme at Symbiosis Institute of Design?
faqs.answer: Yes, SEED is compulsory for admission to the BDes programme at Symbiosis Institute of Design. Passing the exam followed by Portfolio Review and Personal Interaction rounds is necessary. For students appearing for SEED for the first time,SEED preparation tipscan be helpful. Also do fill out theapplication formtimely so that exam preparation can be started early. Other than this, hard work and determination are very important.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores does Symbiosis Institute of Design accept for admission to B.Des?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have completed Class 12 or equivalent, or Class 10 plus a three-year diploma, with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ST) in order to be admitted to the Symbiosis Institute of Design's B.Des program. To be eligible for admission, candidates must also take the Symbiosis Entrance Exam for Design (SEED). The computer-based SEED exam is administered online. The exam measures the candidate's foundational understanding of design, art, craft and culture, environment, and logic in Science and mathematics. Candidates must have a valid SEED score in order to apply for admission to SID. The SEED score is only valid for one year. Candidates may apply to any BDes specialisation while they are taking the final year exam.

review_summary.college_name: Woxsen University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It offers good campus facilities and supportive faculty members.

content.Placements: I am from the 2028 passing out batch of the B.Tech. My branch is CSE data science. Our course focuses on data science subjects along with industry-oriented training, internships, and technical skills development. Around 85-90 percent of the eligible students from our course got placed through the campus recruitment process. The package offered ranges from 6-7 LPA. Infosys is the top recruiting company for our course. A top role offered is a software engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides high-speed Wi-Fi, programming and computing labs, projectors, and a smart board. The library has a large collection of textbooks and reference books. Regular housekeeping is done. The mess provides hygienic and balanced meals, with a rotating weekly menu. First-aid services are provided. It has indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review of Woxsen University.

content.Placements: Placements have been great so far. The highest package is at 24 LPA, the lowest is 7 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. These are the statistics for the first batch to graduate. They graduated last year, and our 2025 batch is yet to graduate. But their placements are impressive so far, considering they are just the second B.Tech batch to graduate.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is really good. Classrooms are interactive, and each class contains 58 students. The hostel and food are also really good. Sports facilities meet international standards, and the campus is full of hangout spots, especially the library, a student hotspot.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good college for teach researchers only

content.Placements: Till now, only one batch has completed with the highest 24 LPA. The current batch is facing a little bit of issues with placements, and now my college is trying to collaborate with new companies to get more students placed. We are the fourth batch of it.
content.Infrastructure: Very good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is provided for every room and classroom. The library contains a minimum number of books on the teach field. The teach contains a large number of GPUs for faster processing and running of programs. The mess has very good food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Blockchain, IoT and Cybersecurity) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Campus is peaceful, wonderful, world-class infrastructure, and greenery.

content.Placements: 80%-90% of students got placed. The highest package is 24 LPA, the lowest is 7 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are JTP, Scientific, Ariqt, and Suhora - 75% of students are getting internships. Top roles include developer, machine learning engineer, and data engineer.
content.Infrastructure: - The whole campus is equipped with Wi-Fi - 10th the largest Library - Fully-furnished Classrooms - Technical advanced Labs - Good Food - Spacious Hostel Room (2 per each room & 3 per each room) - We have a General Store which almost all consists of the things we can buy - We have a hospital for students - We have sports arena and fields and Gyms.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good and safe environment.

content.Placements: Woxsen University has emerged as a leading institution with 80% to 90% of students got placed and with the highest package of 24 LPA, the average is 10 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 7 LPA. JTP and Centrific are the top companies for the B.Tech course. About 75% of students from the course got internships in the field of development.
content.Infrastructure: College has good infrastructure compared to other top-class universities. Good arena for sports to showcase our extracurricular activities. Hostels are so hygienic and clean, and they are so good to stay. Food in the canteen is also good. It's a good and peaceful environment to get a degree.

paragraphs: Woxsen University admissionis a multi-step process. Check below the five simple steps that candidates need to take for Woxsen University course admission:

Candidates need to submit their application form online on the official website of the university before the Woxsen University application last date. The applicant should provide all of the information requested in the application, both in the mandatory and non-mandatory sections.

As per the Woxsen University admission process, candidates will either need to appear for the University-level or the national-level entrance exam. Aspirants must check the entrance exam accepted for the course of their choice. W-JEET and WAT are conducted by the university for admission to specific courses. National-level entrance exams like GMAT, GRE, NMAT, JEE Main, etc., are also accepted.
Candidates shortlisted based on the entrance exam need to come for the personal interview round. The emphasis is on oral communication skills, conduct, confidence, and clarity of expression.

Candidates who meet the Composite Score requirements based on the three steps outlined above will be updated and will receive a provisional offer letter. Candidates will be given seven days to accept or decline the offer.

placement_data.title: Woxsen University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: Woxsen University has announced its placement statistics for 2025 concerning BBA, MBA, BDes, and BTech programs. The placement cell has successfully offered excellent job opportunities to its students. In the 2025 Woxsen University placement, the MBA , BBA , and BTech courses attained a placement rate of 100% . The BDes department achieved a placement rate of 97% . The highest package offered to the students was INR 19 LPA . The highest and average packages offered to the MBA batch 2025 stood at INR 19 LPA and INR 9.10 LPA . respectively.

The highest and median packages offered to the BTech batch 2025 stood at INR 24 LPA and INR 8.5 LPA . respectively. For BDes batch 2025, the highest and median package offered during Woxsen University placements 2025 stood at INR 12 LPA and INR 6.2 LPA . respectively. The BBA (Hons) batch 2025 achieved the highest package of INR 10 LPA and the median package of INR 7 LPA.

hostel.description: Woxsen’s ultra-modern campus sits on a sprawling 200 acre landscape, in a serene and pollution free environment in Hyderabad. Adorned with thoughtfully built indoor & outdoor spaces, the campus has been designed by renowned architects specialized in educational architecture. The living spaces at Woxsen are one of a kind, comparable to any ivy-league institution's student residential facilities. These hostels offer twin sharing and three sharing rooms for boys and girls in separate blocks. The university has a total of 1087 rooms in all the hostel blocks combined. Proper wifi services, water supply, air-conditioned (A/C) & non-air-conditioned rooms, 24/7 security staff, CCTV Surveillance available.

library.description: Heralding a new generation of self-learning centres in higher education, Woxsen University's brand-new Library and Self-Learning Facility- Vithal Gandhi Centre, provides students access to over 18,000 offline and 33000+ online resources. Built on an expansive 70,000 Sq. Ft., the state-of-the-art facility is perhaps one of the largest in India. The centre offers students, faculty, and staff unhindered access to internationally recognized books, journals, annual reports, market studies, reference titles, magazines, and newspapers. This vast collection covers a broad range of topics in management, design, architecture, technology and more. The library offers 10205 books with 18 Journals, 1500 Online Resources, and 500 Audio-Visual Materials. Subscription for leading Magazines, Newspapers & Journals. ICT based resources such as e-books, e-journals, databases. E-resources including JGate plus, Shodhganga, Shodhgangotri and NDL. Institutional Repository for thesis and dissertations. Automatic Book Circulation Kiosks.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good. Classrooms are interactive, and each class contains 58 students. The hostel and food are also really good. Sports facilities meet international standards, and the campus is full of hangout spots, especially the library, a student hotspot.

reviews.review_heading: Woxsen University - great infrastructure but not academics.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied as value for money.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and the quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good place to pursue UG programmes of your interest.

All labs are equipped with adequate amount of equipment and technician to guide the students. The students are encouraged to learn technical skills by practically applying them in the labs.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus facilities, great infrastructure, great placement, and internships.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is included everywhere, in well-designed labs with full full-proof camera and a great library. Great facilities in a hostel, alternative cleaning days, good quality food, good medical facilities, and great grounds for sports and games, good opportunity for people.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the campus is in development and even the students.
reviews.review_text: The courses are great and no complaints about them. The food and accommodation are okay but for the money we pay here, it must be better than this. Labs are dedicated to each school and the total campus is full of Wi-Fi connectivity. Medical facilities are impressive.

reviews.review_heading: Woxsen is the best choice compared to other top universities in the country.
reviews.review_text: Coming to facilities and Woxsen's infrastructure, I can say they are top-notch, and no one will be disappointed compared to any other college in the country. Coming to food and facilities in the college, Woxsen has very good food and hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Really very good and strict college. I will highly recommend others who play sports.
reviews.review_text: In Woxsen University, the infrastructure is really very nice. Everywhere you can easily get Wi-Fi, and labs are also very advanced. Classes are also really good. Canteens are a very nice place to hang out. Hostels are really hygienic, and the food is too delicious. We have a very big sports area and very luxurious games.

reviews.review_heading: Exceptional placements and industry connections, complimented by strong infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is so amazing and beautiful. The library and the material and books are so amazing. Classroom facilities and faculty members are also amazing. Wi-Fi facilities are there in college. Mess food is also good. Medical facilities, sports, and games are also amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members, facilities, food need improvement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, but the facilities need to be improved. There are times when water doesn't come in the washrooms, and being a girl, it's really difficult to deal with this. The library is very good, and a person who is willing to learn can make good use of it. The facilities of the hostel are not very good, but I feel like the new wardens are kind of good. A detailed Jain Deemed-to-be University, School of Design Media and Creative Arts admissions 2026 is as follows:
1: Jain University Application Process

The application process for Jain Deemed-to-be University, School of Design Media and Creative Arts is conducted inonline modefor UG and PG courses. Candidates must visit the university's official website to apply for their desired course.
2: Selection Rounds

Jain Deemed-to-be University, School of Design Media and Creative Arts admissions are entirely entrance-based for all courses. The university conducts a common entrance test, i.e., the Jain Entrance Test (JET) for the selection of candidates for UG & PG courses. After the commencement of the exam, the shortlisted candidates are called for GD & PI rounds as per the course requirements.
3: Final Admission

Once all the selection rounds are completed, the final result will be declared on the university's official website. Candidates who qualify for the selection rounds have to pay a certain amount of course fee to lock their seat for the particular courses.

VIT has excellent sports facilities, as it contains 3 gyms, 3 basketball courts, and many more facilities.

placement_data.title: VIT Vellore Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: VIT Vellore is conducting the placement drive for the Class of 2025. As per the latest report, 868 recruiters participated during VIT Vellore placements 2025 and presented 14044 job offers to the students . The highest package offered stood at INR 1 Cr per annum . The students of the batch 2025 received 3563 super dream and 3499 dream offers from reputed companies. TCS has made the national record by offering 4004 placements to the batch 2025. The top recruiters who visited the Vellore Institute of Technology campus in 2025 include Mircosoft, Amazon, Oracle, Dell, PayPal, Cisco, Bank of America, etc.

According to the the unofficial online sources, the VIT Vellore CSE avearge package secured by BTech batch 2025 stood at INR 8.13 LPA . The median package secured by the BTech CSE batch 2025 was INR 6 LPA. A total of 315 CSE students secured the salary of more than INR 20 LPA. Some of the top hiring recruiters for CSE batch 2025 include Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, Accenture, etc.

faqs.question: What is the fee of VIT University BTech course?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for VIT Vellore BTech ranges between INR 4.9 lakh and 7.8 lakh . The total course fee, includes a caution deposit of INR 3,000 as well. The fee will vary as per the specialisation selected by the candidates. BTech is available in 24 specialisations, namely Computer Science and Engineering (Bioinformatics), Mechanical Engineering , Information Technology, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, etc. Aspirants are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats. Candidates can pay the registration fee via any of the online payment mode. The application fee is INR 1350.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VIT Vellore.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but it is capped at a particular speed and shuts down at 12:30 AM. Overall, the infrastructure is good. It is equipped with gyms, basketball courts, and other sports amenities. Students have to choose the hostel and a mess every new year themselves. Hostels are allotted based on our branch rank.

reviews.review_heading: Best decision of my life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the library and every hostel block, with a pretty good internet speed. Hostel blocks are not less than heaven. There are very clean washrooms and there is no crowd in the washrooms in the morning or during peak hours, too. Food is also great, and the mess serves a variety of options to eat for students. Cybersecurity courses are offered and labs are equipped with the latest technology.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the good infrastructure and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. In VIT, all students will have the same facilities that will not differ. Our college infrastructure is a very good place to study. It will provide Wi-Fi only in the library. Hostels have their specific range, like single person per room, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 sharing rooms. The hostel fee may vary, and for 7 days, they will provide different kinds of food in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Companies hire for R&D roles.
reviews.review_text: Leave intimation, on-duty, and other emergencies require the intimation of the parents. Otherwise, we are not allowed anywhere. Transportation modes like the college bus and public transport such as bus, auto, and cab are available frequently. Mini stationery is available for students to purchase randomly needed things to avoid frequent movement outside the institution.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very well-maintained by the VIT team. Classrooms are very well-maintained with projectors installed in every class. The labs are built with proper equipment and are loaded with ACs. Hostels are well-maintained and well-furnished. The mess food varies from hostel to hostel. VIT has excellent sports facilities, as it contains 3 gyms, 3 basketball courts, and many more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Life at VIT Vellore is full of memories.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. Students need a good rank or a roommate with a good rank to choose better hostel blocks and rooms. Food in Vellore is not bad, and some caterers like SRRC and Darling are very good. For sports and games, there are both outdoor and indoor stadiums inside the hostel area.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the facilities they provide, and the teachers are teaching very well.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in the hostel, and the infrastructure is very good in VIT. The library is the best. Hostel facilities are so good, and the food is served very neatly. We have an ambulance for emergencies. We have badminton in our hostel. The hostel is very good, and the hygiene is very good. They have laundry also.

reviews.review_heading: VIT - Vellore, Tamil Nadu review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are well furnished, and all necessary equipment like an almirah, wardrobe, table, bed, and chair are there. Classrooms are also loaded with the facilities that are required, and they keep us available as soon as possible. Food quality is impressive as they give both veg and non-veg options on the menu. Games and sports are there in bulk, most of the international player comes from this college only.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and campus life are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. I took the H Block hostel apartment type; it is costly but very spacious. Wi-Fi is good, and the food is also good. We have a health center within VIT with a medical shop, and we have a basketball court, badminton court, and all to play. The mess is also neat.

reviews.review_heading: Vellore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure was very beautiful. All blocks had good infrastructure. College only provides Wi-Fi. Labs were very helpful. In library there were all these types of books. Hostel rooms were good and also hygiene food. In total five canteens were there. Good medical and sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Vit Vellore course review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the lab and classes is good. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. In library it is available. The hostel facilities are good and the food is also good. If you're interested in sports, there is a chance you can play, and they give first preference to health in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, good ROI of CAT 1, 2, and strict rules.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good in my college. Library with many books. Wi-Fi is decent, but only in the library and hostels. There are AC and non AC rooms available, and the room you get depends on your CGPA or your roommate CGPA. Food is sometimes good, sometimes not, depending upon what mess you take. We have a volleyball, gym, a tennis table, table tennis, a basketball, a swimming pool, and a big ground for football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Well maintained campus and great environment to learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: The Computer Science department is one of the largest in VIT and hence has been provided with the best facilities, such as well equipped classrooms with smart boards and internet connection. The rooms are large and spacious. The library here is not only big but also has a wide range of books available on every topic necessary. They even have self serving kiosks, which can give us an idea of where the book is present. The hostel is well equipped, and they have good Wi-Fi, good food, AC, and non A...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by VIT Business School, Vellore Institute of Technology, VelloreReviewed on 1 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: VIT University: A place that you cannot miss in your lifetime.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are air-conditioned and smart classrooms, with projectors and speakers, and arch classrooms with rolling chairs. Every room is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. All the hostel rooms are highly maintained, and AC and non-AC rooms are available. All the rooms in the hostel have Wi-Fi connectivity. You have different types of mess options like veg, non-veg, and special.

reviews.review_heading: Vellore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is also good and is full of greenery, which gives fresh air, and hostels are also good on our campus. Every floor contains a speed Wi-Fi network, and classrooms are clean and neat, with well-maintained food in hostel that is healthy and of good taste.

data.description: VIT Vellore is famous for its top-notch faculty. The professors and associate/assistant professors are dedicated to teaching and research among students. The teaching staff comes from prestigious academic backgrounds across institutions. Students feel free to approach the professors as they are empathetic to their queries.

paragraphs: Each year, Vellore Institute of Technology offers scholarships in the form of tuition waivers and freeships. While merit scholarships are awarded to class toppers, economically challenged students are provided need-based financial assistance. Furthermore, NRI and foreign students are given scholarships upon presenting meritorious records. Students from rural backgrounds who secure top ranks in VITEEE at the district level (in Tamil Nadu only) are given free education.

Students who wish to pursue MTech are also given scholarships, given that they score well in the GATE exam. In addition, scholarships are given to students who excel in sports and games. Financial assistance is also provided to students who wish to do their project work in partner universities and institutions abroad, under the Semester Abroad Programme (SAP). In order to encourage the students to pursue active research, VIT also awards appropriate research associateships to meritorious and needy students.

hostel.description:
IIAD offers separate hostels for boys and girls on ‘first-come-first-serve’ basis. As these facilities are limited, so do apply early to book your room. 

Residents of the hostels can choose rooms between:
Single occupancy
twin-sharing
triple-sharing
four-sharing

All rooms have bathrooms and are furnished with a bed, study table, chair, bookrack, wardrobe, air conditioning, geysers etc. Some of the shared amenities include refrigerator, microwave, electric kettle, RO water purifier, washing machine, lounge area and wi-fi. 

Residents have easy access to daily utilities in the neighborhood. There are several pharmacies, groceries and convenience stores, as well as entertainment options such as cinema halls and dine-in/home delivery restaurants.

The safety of students at the hostel is given the highest priority. The accommodation has 24/7 security.

reviews.review_heading: Our institute has very good faculty members and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our institute is good that includes Wi-Fi, a Mac lab, smart classrooms, a library, a lounge area, fashion studios, a product lab, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Art and Design.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are located in one of the most the fanciest parts of Delhi (East of Kailash). Our hostel is loaded with home-like facilities. Our hostel is well connected to metro, and that is a plus. The rooms are clean, the food in the hostel and canteen is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Art and Design.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is one of the best in Delhi. The hostel is very beautiful and extremely clean. Staying in the hostel helped save a lot of time, and there, I was also able to make friends for life. Both the canteen and mess have amazing food options. The library is filled with books and is extremely educational.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Art and Design.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel is located in East of Kailash, which is one of the expensive areas of Delhi. Hostel rooms are quite spacious and very clean as well. Both the hostel and the campus have high-speed Wi-Fi. Mess and canteen serve amazing food. We have digital resource labs stacked with MAC computers. Our library has books related to all the courses.

reviews.review_heading: You will have an amazing learning experience which enriches your design thinking skills.
reviews.review_text: Our college has an amazing infrastructure, very functional classrooms, studios and labs. Our college is absolutely well maintained and clean, and 100% hygiene is maintained in canteen and washrooms. There are very friendly vibes inside the classrooms for a perfect teaching and learning environment. IIAD also provides a hostel facility, which is well-equipped and is not far from college.

reviews.review_heading: The course curriculum provided by the college is really comprehensive.
reviews.review_text: IIAD has all the required facilities, from advanced classrooms, studios, labs, sports arena, cafeteria, to the library, etc. It also has separate girls and boys hostel. Along with that, it has different clubs for students such as theatre, dance, music, etc. which helps in the overall development of the students.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty at IIAD are experienced.
reviews.review_text: IIAD has a good infrastructure with all the required facilities. It has course-specific labs and studios apart from that, it has Wi-Fi, library, cafeteria, etc. It also has separate boys and girls hostels. Overall, students have all the required facilitate in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: IIAD has one of the best infrastructures.
reviews.review_text: IIAD has one of the best infrastructures for a design college in the country. Since learning and teaching are studio-based, it is really important to have course-specific labs and studios. Apart from that, the college has a library, Wi-Fi, cafeteria, auditorium, etc. It also has separate girls and boys hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Life at IIAD as a fashion design student.
reviews.review_text: I am from the Delhi NCR region so I wasn't living at the hostel but some of my friends were. They had a wonderful experience. There are separate hostels for boys and girls that are fully furnished, safe and have all the required facilities. The campus itself is great and since we spend so much time there I am glad it is structured in a way that keeps in mind our needs and requirements. We have large studio spaces, a material lab, library, outdoor cafeteria, gaming room etc. This allows for work ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Art and Design.
reviews.review_text: Since I am from Delhi, I did not apply for a hostel. However, our college offers separate hostels for boys and girls. Hostels are spacious, safe and have all the amenities, and I came to know it because many of my friends stayed there. The infrastructure of our college is great. I love the campus and really enjoying working in huge studio spaces and spending time with my classmates in the outdoor canteen and gaming room.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Art and Design.
reviews.review_text: There are no classrooms. Instead, we work and learn in huge studio spaces. Labs are equipped with Mac computers which help us in designing. Outdoor canteen is my favourite, and we spend a lot of our free time there. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. I am staying in a hostel, and it is very fun. It is also close to the market and the metro station, which is making travelling convenient.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college to study.
reviews.review_text: The college runs on studio basis, so we don't have classes. We have studios to work. Every resource like machines, tables, projectors, chairs, canteen, hall, air-conditioners and Wi-Fi are available. Hostel facilities are average as I heard from our classmates living there. People who shift from some other places to Delhi finds it difficult to adjust anywhere else, and it is a common problem which you'll face irrespective of hostel services.

reviews.review_heading: College has very good placements and internship opportunities for the students of our course.
reviews.review_text: College has very good infrastructure for our course. All the facilities offered by the college to the students were of good quality. College has labs, library etc. To support the students learning. Canteen, sports and various other necessary facilities were available at the college campus for the students. College campus is fully secured. College has separate hostel for the girls and boys which offers good quality facilities to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a lot to learn, understand, and experience.
reviews.review_text: The college provides the best amenities. Their studios are huge and spacious. The campus is peaceful but not huge. The studios are extremely good. There are also lounges where you can play indoor games. The food served at the canteen is good and worth the price.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with all the help from the faculty and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
1. The entire college is given a Wi-fi limit of 1GB daily. The library is a centre in the college for the best books on design, the librarian is a person aware of each and every book and updates students with the latest book in the Library. 
2. I don't use the college hostel. The canteen serves hot and delicious food daily. Medical facilities are available in the student support cell of the college with a first aid kit and the college is situated to one of India's best hospitals-Apollo hospital.

review_summary.college_name: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons) in Chemistry with Botany - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College placement is not so good, their percentage is very low.

content.Placements: The strength of my class is 79. Almost all students get an internship. Colleges offer students the opportunity to got internship from another college or industry. If they do not approach any industry or college, then the college itself provides the internship. The average package forwarded in my courses is Rs. 50000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Lab in the first and 2nd semester is done once a week, and in the third semester it is twice a week, and in the 4th semester it is 4 days a week. There are two batches of Chemistry. The maximum number of students doing lab together is 30 or more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want a good package, then you should join this college.

content.Placements: Almost 95-96 percent of students in electrical have been placed. The highest package given is 1.2 crore per annum, which was in the field of cybersecurity. The lowest is around 12 LPA, and the average package is around 27 LPA, while the median is around 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and Nvidia. Around 50 percent of students from electrical engineering grab an internship. Specifically, this year, 55 students got an internship. [8 core and rest non-core ] Top roles include SDE, cybersecurity, VLSI designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Sometimes there is a problem with Wi-Fi connectivity in our hostel rooms. The library is very good, and it contains all types of books that are required. Classrooms are okay. Labs are very good, but some of the equipment has mechanical errors. The medical facility is excellent. Food quality depends on which type of mess you have joined, like in a sattvik mess, where Jain food is served, the quality of food is excellent compared to other messes. The sports facility is also very good. The canteen also provides good food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college IIT BHU because of facilities and good placement in 2026.

content.Placements: In the electronics branch, the placement percentage is approximately 81 percent. The highest package is 90 LPA, the lowest is 7.5 LPA, and the average is 23.5 LPA. Top companies are Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia. 40 percent of students got internships in core jobs, where the major company was Nvidia, and a few also got internships in SDE. Roles include VLSI, embedded systems, and PCB.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good at IIT BHU. Wi-Fi covers the entire campus, and classrooms are fully modernized. There are 4 lecture theatres in our college. For freshers, IIT BHU has the best hostel among all IITs, named PC Ray Hostel, which covers all required infrastructure and is newly made, so it looks aesthetic as well. There are 3 huge grounds in IIT BHU, which cover facilities for all sports. We have SAC for indoor games and a newly made gym, which is the biggest sports auditorium as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college is the best for serious students.

content.Placements: There were very few placement offers, because most of the students preferred higher studies in their respective fields. Actually, since there was no specific placement cell for UG students, there was a very low number of students who got placed, i.e., 30-40 percent of students were getting placed or less than that.
content.Infrastructure: There was a decent hostel in our college, which was not too good, but there were some basic facilities provided by the hostel, like free Wi-Fi, and there was also a place for playing outdoor games. Overall, it was 7/10, and the infrastructure of the course was good. You don't have much pressure, you have time to explore new things and find your interests.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Dairy Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Average for dairy, above average for college life.

content.Placements: The placement scenario of the college is moderate. On average, students receive salary packages ranging from 5 to 6 LPA. Lactalis, Amul and Vadilal visit the campus for recruitment. The placements at the college are average, but the table and its BHU, so in future it will develop for sure.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good and well-maintained infrastructure that supports both academic and extracurricular activities. Our college is big, but our department isn't; we need more strength as students and as teachers, too. Classrooms and laboratories are properly equipped. Only ICAR students can get a hostel (SRK HOSTEL).

paragraphs: BHU admissionsare primarily entrance-based. All Indian applicants are required to take the CUET-UG exam conducted by the NTA. Candidates must apply online on the NTA CUET official website to register themselves. For PG courses, aspirants with a valid CUET-PG score can apply. Admission to some courses can be merit-based. BHU considers CUET-UG scores and normalised scores to create merit lists for each course.
What is the BHU Application Process 2026?

For UG courses admission through CUET, candidates have to complete theCUET-UG application process. Likewise, forBHU PG admissions, theCUET-PG applicationprocess has to be completed. For other courses, the aspirants can apply through BHU official website.

BHU counselling process for PG courses through CUET-PG is carried out in online mode. Registrations for it get started before CUET results are out and open after that for scorecard upload. Find below the detailed procedure of BHU CUET-PG counselling:
1 -Register on theBHU admission portal

Visit the university's official website(bhuonline.in)to participate in the online counselling process. To register, enter yourNTA application number, and other details along with your email ID and a passwordto activate the registration account.

Login with the Email ID and password entered during registration. After login, fill out the application and upload documents. Candidates must upload the documents inPDF/JPEG format. Moreover, the required documents are enlisted below:
Matriculation or its equivalent certificate
Class 12 mark sheet
Bachelor's mark sheet (make a single file of marks sheet of all semesters and then upload the same as a single document)
Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) and income certificate (SC/ST)
PwD certificate (if applicable)
BHU employee certificate (if applicable)
Certificate if admission under sports quota
Scanned copy of a recent colour photograph & signature
3 -Pay the BHU Counselling Registration Fee

In order to register successfully, anon-refundablefee has to be paid via debit card/credit card/net banking. Candidates canedit the application before fee payment. Find below the registration fee for each of the categories:
4 -Preference Entry Page

The preference entry page opens after the registration fee payment. Candidates can fill in their preferences separately for all the programmes in this form. Moreover, the result for the first seat allotment is declared within 8 to 10 days (approximately) after the publication of theCUET-PG result. Further, subsequent rounds for regular/paid fee seats for the BHU and affiliated colleges are carried out.

BHU feesinclude various components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, security deposit, library fees, etc. The fee payment shall be accepted annually or semester-wise. BHU fee structure varies depending upon the chosen course. It also varies for regular and paid seats. Candidates wanting to apply for afee refund from BHUhave to fill out a form. The university provides seat reservations toSC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged. Moreover, the university has also paid seats (a maximum of 15% of the total seats). faqs.question: Does BHU accept CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Banaras Hindu University accept CUET score for multiple UG courses, including BA (Hons), BCom (Hons) BSc (Hons), etc. The university is also offering admission to its PG courses based on merit in CUET-PG. Aspirants who meet the eligibility requirements can register on the BHU admission portal for counselling. The admission is done in order of merit based on the normalised score of the CUET (PG) and reservation policy as per the provisions laid down in the BHU PET Information Brochure.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for the BHU UET?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET-UG scores for admission to several UG courses. Candidates seeking admission to BHU must apply online to register themselves. Follow the step-wise admission process as given below:The BHU application process is conducted in online mode through the official website of NTA (nta.ac.in). The fee for General category students is INR 750, INR 700 for OBC-NCL/EWS, and INR 650 for SC/ST/PwD/Transgender.Candidates need to download the admit card by visiting the official website of CUET 2025 and clicking on 'Download CUET Admit Card'.After the declaration of the CUET result, students seeking admission to BHU UG courses are required to apply online for CUET-UG Counselling on the BHU UG admission portal.Further, candidates are required to participate in an online counselling process for provisional admission to the course (s). After that, the final seat allotment will be done by BHU.

faqs.question: What is the last date for BHU admission?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET scores for admission to UG and PG courses. The admissions are over within few weeks of CUET counselling. CUET-PG is usually jeld in March whereas, CUET-UG takes place in May. Students must check the complete schedule for exact dates. CUET applications for the coming year will begin in February and continue till April.

faqs.question: Can a one-year dropper student get admission into BHU?
faqs.answer: Banaras Hindu University course admissions is entrance-based for most of the programmes. Thus, one-year dropper student can apply for the desired course, however, qualifying the respective entrance is the a must. Apart from this, aspirant should meet the course-specific minimum eligibility requirements as well.Moreover, the student can be asked to submit an application regarding the reason for drop out. Sometimes even this is not required.

paragraphs: The highest and average package recorded during BHU MBA & MBA IB placements 2025 were INR 19.8 LPA and INR 10.1 LPA , respectively. For MBA Agri-Business course, the highest and average package recorded this year were INR 16 LPA and INR 8.7 LPA . During Banaras Hindu University MBA and MBA IB placements 2025, most number of profiles offered was of Consultant whereas for MBA Agri-Business program, Management Trainee emerged as the top profile.

According to the NIRF report 2025 released the median package offered to UG 3 year was INR 8 LPA during the BHU placements 2024. Moreover, the median packages offered to UG 4 Year and UG 5 Year were INR 9 LPA and INR 16 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package received during BHU placement 2024 for PG 2-year and PG 3-year programs were INR 9 LPA and INR 13.5 LPA , respectively.

Apart from this, the course aspirants must fulfil the course-specific eligibility requirements as well.

faqs.question: What are the career options available after completing a BCom degree course?
faqs.answer: BCom course is the gateway to job opportunities in several fields such as Accounting, Finance, Economics, Taxation, Insurance, etc. One can become an Accountant, Financial Analyst, Auditor, etc. after graduating with a BCom degree. This degree is also beneficial to those students who want to run their own businesses. Because of the variety of work prospects it gives, BCom is one of the most popular undergraduate educational programmes. Commerce is the nation's most important industry, and it has a huge impact on the economy. The expanding economy has resulted in a variety of job opportunities in the business sector. As a result, a Bachelor of Commerce degree can lead to a lucrative career.

faqs.question: How much does B.Pharma at The Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University cost?
faqs.answer: The cost of a four-year Bachelor of Pharmacy (Pharmacognosy) programme at Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University (RTMNU) is INR 65,340. NIRF Pharmacy Ranks places the university at #51 out of 125, but despite this, it offers a comprehensive pharmaceutical sciences education. A variety of pharmacy topics are likely covered in the course material, with pharmacognosy—the study of pharmaceuticals derived from plants and animals—getting special attention. After completing this specialisation, students will be equipped to work in manufacturing, quality control, research, and other departments within the pharmaceutical industry. In addition, the university's ranking among India's top 100 pharmacy schools adds credibility to the curriculum's quality and the graduates' potential outcomes.

review_content.Placements: Honestly, the campus placements here are fantastic. If you have skills, it's pretty straightforward to get placed with a decent package. We're talking about a 100% placement rate because more than enough companies are coming to our campus. It's not unusual for a student to end up with two job offers. review_content.Infrastructure: In spite of the college's overall infrastructure being just alright, the campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-used labs, comfortable classrooms, and extensive library become a great source of satisfaction. The vast array of textbooks and other materials available on campus removes the necessity for students to buy many of the resources from outside. Students can also avail themselves of transportation and on-campus housing facilities in case they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we talk about the food menu, it is quite good, but if more items of students' choice are introduced, it will surely be beneficial.

course_faqs.question: What is the tuition fees for PhD courses at IIT Hyderabad?
course_faqs.answer: IIT Hyderabad PhD tuition fees is INR 1 lakh for the academic year 2026. This component is charged on per semester basis at INR 10,000, each for all PhD courses. For external category students, the PhD course fees at IIT Hyderabad is INR 3.5 lakh.

course_faqs.question: Is the PhD fees refundable at IIT Hyderabad?
course_faqs.answer: IIT Hyderabad PhD admission fees is refundable for candidates who decide to cancel their admissions. The institute follows the UGC guidelines to offer refunds to such candidates.The UGC guidelines provide for refunds to candidates who decide to cancel their admission within 30 days of the commencement of the course. Earlier cancellation will result in higher percentage of refunds.

overview_faqs.question: What is the tuition fees of BTech at IIT Hyderabad?
overview_faqs.answer: IIT Hyderabad offers BTech course three streams such as Engineering, IT & Software and Science. As per official website, the total BTech tuition fee is INR 8 lakh. However, the one-time fee for the course is INR 17,000.

overview_faqs.question: What is the BTech fees at IIT Hyderabad?
overview_faqs.answer: The BTech fees at IIT Hyderabad is currently unknown for the academic year 2026. Candidates who wish to learn the IIT Hyderabad fees will need to wait until the BTech admissions have been concluded.The BTech admissions at IIT Hyderabad are concluded after the JoSAA counseling rounds in the month of July.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for 2 years MSc in IIT Hyderabad?

Aspirants can also review the fee structure while comparing institutes. The fees at IIT Hyderabad include various components such as tuition fees, caution deposits, hostel charges, and mess charges.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Hyderabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Ph.D. in Physics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Do your best hardwork to get into IIT.

content.Placements: Placements were very good. Almost all students get placed. Most of my friends got placed. Mostly students were placed in different top universities as associate professors. Some students were getting internships from foreign countries like Japan, Russia, the UK, USA universities. Good internship opportunities were available for all branches. You can receive information regarding these from the Office of Career Service OCS IITH. A lot of Japanese companies hire from here.
content.Infrastructure: Libraries were the best. They look like fictional libraries any reader would just love. Almost all genres were available. There was online checking facility of availability of books. Seating spaces were very creative specially crafted for studying and peaceful work. Classrooms were very good. Air conditioning, projectors, TV, stepped platform, etc. The premises are very friendly. There is a gym and track and all facilities separately for each sport. Track for running, basketball court, tennis court, football ground, cricket ground, closed and open, open running track, closed running track, volleyball court etc separately.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: IIT Hyderabad is a good college.

content.Placements: From the 7th semester, students are eligible for campus placements. Some companies that visit the college are Samsung Research, Adobe Research, and Intel. The highest package offered this year is 90 LPA, and the average package offered is 23 LPA. The percentage of students who get placements is 74.90 percent. I am still trying to figure out whether to do higher studies or to do a job. Wipro and Suzuki provide many internship opportunities. Many consulting companies also come to the college. Developing ourselves must be our priority after joining the college because there are so many opportunities for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of IIT Hyderabad College.

content.Placements: Honestly, the campus placements here are fantastic. If you have skills, it's pretty straightforward to get placed with a decent package. We're talking about a 100% placement rate because more than enough companies are coming to our campus. It's not unusual for a student to end up with two job offers. The highest and the lowest packages vary by branch, but I'd say the top package can reach up to 50 LPA, while the lowest sits around 15 LPA-16 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: In spite of the college's overall infrastructure being just alright, the campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-used labs, comfortable classrooms, and extensive library become a great source of satisfaction. The vast array of textbooks and other materials available on campus removes the necessity for students to buy many of the resources from outside. Students can also avail themselves of transportation and on-campus housing facilities in case they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we talk about the food menu, it is quite good, but if more items of students' choice are introduced, it will surely be beneficial.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Industrial Chemistry - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Campus Life at IIT Hyderabad.

content.Placements: 70% were placed in my college last year. The highest package is 30 LPA. All students got an internship in our branch. It is one of the best branches at IIT Hyderabad. You can also prepare for tech. The course of our branches is well prepared and organised.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our course is also very nice. Our department consists of a building in which most of the rooms belong to labs. In every room, you will get free Wi-Fi. The canteen will serve at least five items per day, and the taste is also very nice.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Engineering Physics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Awesome infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: The course I chose, engineering physics is more research-oriented. This year, only 5 out of 25 students got placed. But I am sure only 10-15 applied for placements as most are inclined to research. Internships are offered by multiple types of companies like software companies but also other ones like LIGO. Some people did internships in universities in Germany too.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is excellent, spacious, and has charming architecture. There are single rooms for 2nd years and above. The food in the mess is good too with lots of variety even if it tends to get boring after a while. The library is also known as the Knowledge Research Center. It is very big with lots of books and e-resources. Labs are equipped with the best possible and updated equipment. The Wi-Fi is super fast here, in the full campus.

admission_overview.title: IIT Hyderabad Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: IIT Hyderabad Admission 2026 is open. The college offers UG, PG, professional, and doctoral programmes in the field of Engineering, Design, Sciences, and Liberal Arts. Admissions to IIT Hyderabad are primarily entrance-based. BTech applicants must clear JEE Main and JEE Advanced, followed by JoSAA counselling. BDes requires UCEED, MTech requires GATE, and MDes requires CEED scores. Selection to PG and PhD programmes may also involve departmental screening and interviews. Direct admission is offered to eligible IIT graduates in select PG programmes.

paragraphs: IIT Hyderabad has a multi-step admission process which students need to follow to get into the institute. The process includes appearing for the relevant entrance exam, application process, counselling and subsequent admission.The JEE Advanced 2026 official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria.A step-by-stepadmission process of IIT Hyderabadis as mentioned below:
Application Process

Students interested in getting into IIT Hyderabad can submit the online application form for course-specific entrance exams or college, depending on the course they wish to get into. Students can register to the below-mentioned list to learn about the entrance tests required for some of thepopular IIT Hyderabad courses:
Selection Criteria and Release of Merit List

After completion of the registration process, applicants need to go through the course-based entrance exam, followed by other selection rounds. After the selection rounds are completed, they need to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation. For aPhD, merit lists are released on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted students).
Step 3: Admission Confirmation at IIT Hyderabad
After completion of the selection rounds, applicants who are shortlisted can submit the admission charges and confirm their admission to the relevant course at IIT Hyderabad.

The IIT Hyderabad's fee varies with the course selected by the candidate. However, the tuition fee for IIT Hyderabad ranges between INR 17,000 to INR 8 lakh. Candidates can check below the table that mentions a list of IIT Hyderabad courses along with their fees:

paragraphs: A total of 389 students registered and 374 students were placed during IIT Hyderabad placement 2025. 353 companies registered out of which 17 were international companies . More than 710 offers were made out of which 53 were international offers . A total of 130 PPOs were made during IITH placement 2025. The highest and the average package stood at INR 128 LPA and INR 33.96 LPA, respectively.

For the IIT Hyderabad placements 2024, the highest package given was INR 90 LPA and the average package received was INR 22.5 LPA. For the MSc and MTech program, the highest package stood at INR 58 LPA. A total of 521 offers were made by 320 companies. BTech, MTech and PhD program placement rate was 86.67%, 76.47% and 100% , respectively. At the end of season 2024, a total of 493 students were placed, and 43 international offers were seen.

Moreover, the highest stipend offered during summer internships for the batch 2023-2024 was INR 2 lakh per month and the average stipend stood at INR 79,000 per month . The total count of summer internships was 159 and semester internships was 73 .

faqs.answer: The BTech fees at IIT Hyderabad is currently unknown for the academic year 2026. Based on the rankings from NIRF, IIT Hyderabad outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad's rank is #12, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad climbed 1 rank to #7 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It can be seen that; in the 'Research Institutions' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad's rank is #15, the same as last year's rank in the 'Research Institutions' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Innovation' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Hyderabad fell 3 ranks to #6 rank in the 'Innovation' category by the NIRF ranking.

qs_world.description:
IIT Hyderabad has been ranked well by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category. Through the years, the QS World University Rankings for IIT Hyderabad indicate the institute's strong performance in important areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's good reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the QS World University Rankings. It has been seen that in the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have shown an increasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2026, IIT Hyderabad climbed 17 ranks to #664 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Asia', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Hyderabad climbed 50 ranks to #270 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Southern Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, IIT Hyderabad climbed 21 ranks to #60 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.

sports.description: IIT Hyderabad offer different sports facilities to promote holistic development and sportsmanship among students. The institute offers both indoor and outdoor facilities. There is a modern sports complex with cricket grounds, football fields, hockey fields, tennis courts, etc. The indoor sports facilities at the institute include a gymnasium, badminton courts, squash and table tennis.

reviews.review_heading: Do your best hardwork to get into IIT.
reviews.review_text: Libraries were the best. They look like fictional libraries any reader would just love. Almost all genres were available. There was online checking facility of availability of books. Seating spaces were very creative specially crafted for studying and peaceful work. Classrooms were very good. Air conditioning, projectors, TV, stepped platform, etc. The premises are very friendly. There is a gym and track and all facilities separately for each sport. Track for running, basketball court, tennis co...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad is a good college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the most beautiful and best thing I liked. All buildings have a form of Japanese infrastructure. The maintenance of the hostels is so poor. The food in the mess is not very good. It is not so spicy, and mainly, South Indians don't like the food. The library is very good and very accessible. All classrooms are well-equipped with projectors and screens for easy and good learning.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Hyderabad College.
reviews.review_text: In spite of the college's overall infrastructure being just alright, the campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-used labs, comfortable classrooms, and extensive library become a great source of satisfaction. The vast array of textbooks and other materials available on campus removes the necessity for students to buy many of the resources from outside. Students can also avail themselves of transportation and on-campus housing facilities in case they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we t...

reviews.review_heading: Campus Life at IIT Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our course is also very nice. Our department consists of a building in which most of the rooms belong to labs. In every room, you will get free Wi-Fi. The canteen will serve at least five items per day, and the taste is also very nice.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is excellent, spacious, and has charming architecture. There are single rooms for 2nd years and above. The food in the mess is good too with lots of variety even if it tends to get boring after a while. The library is also known as the Knowledge Research Center. It is very big with lots of books and e-resources. Labs are equipped with the best possible and updated equipment. The Wi-Fi is super fast here, in the full campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, faculty and facilities, but limited core placements in mechanical.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in hostels, mess, canteen, academic blocks, etc. The new library opened last year and is very big, with access to a variety of books. Labs are well-equipped. The new sports complex opened last year and has all games available. Mess food is not good most of the time.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Technology has the best architecture.
reviews.review_text: IIT Hyderabad's 576-acre campus features sustainable architecture, single-occupancy hostels with radiant cooling, diverse dining options, and modern sports facilities. The college has a well-equipped gym, 24/7 medical services, banking, and a supermarket. It ensures a holistic student experience.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in college is good. Everything is fine with no remarks.
reviews.review_text: Facilities they provide are pretty good and the infrastructure is awesome. We get single-room occupancy. The food is okay, quite good for South Indians but not for North Indians. The canteen is pretty decent. Medical and sports were superb and there is no remark on them.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad: The Dream College.
reviews.review_text: Since the hostels for the UG students were recently constructed they are neat clean and spacious. There is also the facility of radiant cooling which is a game change in the scorching heat of Hyderabad. The sports complex offers a wide range of sports facilities which are world-class. Though the mess food is hygienic and nutritional but the taste is not so good.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad and its beauty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and the infrastructure is inspired by Japanese architecture. There is unlimited Wi-Fi on the campus, and classrooms are well-air-conditioned. The hostel rooms use radiant cooling techniques. The mess food is good in the canteen, and get everything we need.

reviews.review_heading: IITH - The next best IIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in IITH is just amazing. Many buildings here are inspired by Japanese architecture. Classrooms are vast, modern, and equipped with ACs. Hostels are new and clean. All the facilities provided are worth every penny paid. Mess food is also great but everyone may not like it. There are canteens and cafeterias with many eateries.

reviews.review_heading: The highest-growing IIT is IIT Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: All types of facilities are provided in IITs. IITH also has all types of facilities. IITH have one of the best architecture in India inspired by Japanese architecture. It has all types of labs, research facilities, and full Wi-Fi all over the campus. The mess, canteen, medical facilities, and sports are the best in India.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied & amazed by the awesome infrastructure, but would have loved some more greenery on campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-class. We have 10-floor hostel buildings with single-sharing rooms equipped with a radiant cooling system. The rooms are of single occupancy. The campus has multiple department buildings, and every building is unique and magnificent. The library is also very huge, with a lot of study rooms, discussion rooms, study tables, etc. The food in the mess is also quite satisfactory. The quality is good, and they have a fixed weekly menu. Each room in the hostel has a LAN port, ...

reviews.review_heading: IITH is one of the best campuses for research and it is the fastest-growing IIT.
reviews.review_text: Here we will get all the facilities in a good manner like Wi-Fi, classrooms and library. The library is one of the best places to enjoy on campus. Mess food is not up to the mark. We have good sports facilities. The canteen is also good. There are around 20 hostels.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Hyderabad boasts excellent placements and a fantastic infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are first-rate, including first-rate labs and amenities like Wi-Fi. The library is excellent, and the classrooms are spacious. Additionally, the college offers hostel accommodation where we may eat well. Compared to the canteen, the mess is clean and has a wider selection of food. Sports and games materials and activities are offered, as are medical amenities.

The university accepts scores in MHT CET, NEET, GATE, GPAT, CAT, MAT, etc. for admission to specific courses. Mumbai University offers over 200 courses at UG, PG, diploma, doctoral and certifcate levels. The programmes are offered via 50 departments, 12 specialised centres, 781 affiliated colleges, two main campuses, two-sub campuses and two model colleges. The university offers courses across various streams such as Arts, Science, Education, Commerce, Science, etc. Besides, Mumbai University also offers courses in distance education mode through its Institute of Distance and Open Learning (IDOL).

paragraphs: Mumbai University admissionsare merit and entrance-based. The university opens admission for UG courses usually in May with the release of admission form, followed by the merit list. For PG programmes, the registration also opens in May and continues till June. The university releases the merit list of PG programmes in June. Check below step-wise MU admission process:
Mumbai University Application Process

The university accepts applications via online mode. Applications are shortlisted based on the scores of the candidates in the respective entrance exams. For UG courses, admission is granted based on the last qualifying exam scores of the candidates. Acutoff listmay also be released for someUniversity of Mumbai course admissions.
Personal Interview & Group Discussion
For some of the PG courses, the shortlisted candidates are further called for personal interviews and group discussions. The final selection is done based on overall performance in selection rounds.
Admission Confirmation

Selected candidates can further pay the required admission fee to confirm their seat. Candidates may have to visit the university/respective college campus to submit important documents and pay theMU feefor admission confirmation.

faqs.question: Is Mumbai University private or Government university?
faqs.answer: Established in 1857,Mumbai University(MU) is astate-run institution,recognised by theUGCand accredited with anA++ grade by the NAAC.According to the NIRF Ranking 2024, Mumbai University is at 61 position among the top Universities in India. University of Mumbai offers more than 200 Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, Doctoral, and Certificate programmes in Engineering, Arts, Science, Management, Law, etc. Mumbai University also provides distance learning programmes through itsInstitute of Distance and Open Learning (IDOL Mumbai University), in addition to its full-time and part-time courses.

faqs.question: Can I do MBA without CAT at Mumbai University?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can pursue MBA without CAT at Mumbai University.  CAT is not only the entrance exam applicable for the selection process at Mumbai university. Candidates can always go for other qualifying exams likeMAT,XAT,CMAT,MAH CET,ATMA,GMAT,NMAT,SNAP,SMATfor admission to the MBA course at Mumbai University.

placement_data.title: Mumbai University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The placement details of 2025 batch are yet to be released on the official website of University of Mumbai. However, the University has released the NIRF report 2025 which includes the placement details fo the batch 2024. According to the report, the median package received by UG 3-year and PG 2-year students in 2024 was INR 8.6 LPA and INR 20 LPA .

Other than this, the highest and average package offered during MMS placements 2024 was INR 10 LPA and INR 5.37 LPA . MSc Finance students revived highest and average package of INR 8 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA .
Note: The MMS and MSc Finance placement details are from MU’s Alkesh Dinesh Mody Institute for Financial and Management Studies.

Additionally, the highest and average stipend received during summer internships 2024 was INR 30,000 and INR 10,000. Further, Banking & Insurance emerged as the top recruiting sector with summer placement distribution of 29.6%.
