reviews.review_heading: Good college in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Good classrooms with AC, Wi-Fi, and library by Brigade Groups. Good infrastructure facilities with sports and games, and the canteen is well maintained and has lots of options. Dispensary is available with medications. Overall a good college to choose from.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely a waste of money, time, and energy.
reviews.review_text: The quality of Wi-Fi has improved recently, and before, it was quite poor. Labs are open to students now, and I do not have much information on labs. Classrooms are pretty decent. The library is pretty good, especially after the construction of the new library. The canteen is good, and the food is the worst. Sports are there just for the namesake. Medical facilities are pretty good.

reviews.review_heading: Decent enough college for studio guys with good campus life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. As it is a new college, infrastructure is also great. Wi-Fi is pretty decent. Classrooms are comfortable and library is the best part of college. Sports ground is shared with RVCE and in total it is worth as a place to chill and enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: Life at RV University and the student life.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in every corner of the campus. Labs are well-equipped. We have a top-class library. I don't know much about the hostel because I am from Bangalore. I have heard from my friends that the food is good in hostel. For sports and games, we have a proper ground.

reviews.review_heading: I have a problem with attendance. Placements are the best.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice but they are constructing more. Wi-Fi and classrooms are top-notch. They have a big library, which is good. The food in the canteen is good we have MM Foods, as well as both small and large Mingos. I don't know much about sports. Games are good, we play treasure hunts, escape rooms, and all events.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with education like teaching, placements, and all over it's good.
reviews.review_text: We have good classroom. Wi-Fi connection and lab facilities are available. There is a hospital inside the college for any emergency. We have two good canteens for lunch. There are lots of clubs for individual fields like sports, dance, singing, etc. There is a good hostel facility with basic needs and all.

reviews.review_heading: Impressive but need more improvement .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for our course is really good, no issues with the Wi-Fi, labs are well-equipped, classrooms are clean, we have huge library in the campus which has been opened recently. When it comes to hostel facilities, Little improvement of food is required and other amenities like washing machines gym and all are provided there is a parking space for hostlers separately if they have vehicle.

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing. I recommend everyone to join this college.
reviews.review_text: College provides good Wi-Fi speed, and classrooms are well-maintained and hygienic. New library has opened recently in RVU is very fantastic. Hostel facilities are amazing, to be honest. The quality of the food is decent. Canteen food is excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Pretty much not satisfied because of the timings and not fests and interactive things in 2024.
reviews.review_text: Our has good infrastructure and they are still building so many blocks for different departments. The newest thing is the rvu library it's one of the main monument of rvu. The facalties are very good and interactive with the students. The canteen has good food.

reviews.review_heading: RV University isn't too bad of place to join. It's really shaping up.
reviews.review_text: Each classroom has a smart board, and if no smart board, we have a smart projector. We recently got a new library, and I've never been so happy; it's absolutely massive, and we have privacy booths inside too. It's really nice. I'm not in the hostel, so I'm not sure, but I haven't heard great things from my friends.

reviews.review_heading: Yet to be satisfied with the greenery on campus.
reviews.review_text: If we come to the infrastructure of the college, it is an under-construction building as it is new. The management is now planning to build a variety of buildings for different courses separately, and there are Wi-Fi facilities, labs, and a beautiful library for us to read.

reviews.review_heading: RV University from the POV of a Student of RVU.
reviews.review_text: Well, some buildings for RVU are still under construction, but the ones that are done are extremely modern and cool. I'm not a part of the hostel, but I've heard from my friends who are that the rooms are really great, but the food quality is kind of okay-ish.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the RV University.
reviews.review_text: Half of the building is under construction, but classrooms are not bad, and they will be renovated later. There is Wi-Fi everywhere in the building. There was no vacancy in the hostel (150+ girls on the waiting list), so I had to look for PG accommodation. Canteen is a bit far from our course building, but the food is good. They have a health center on campus. The college has a ground, and they conduct sports day and encourage us to participate in student club activities as well.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and faculty are good, and students have to catch up on things along with it.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and everything are good. The library is small. The new building for the library will be soon available. There are 2-3 hostels. Some hostels' maintenance is good. The food is average. Some hostels' food is good. The maintenance is average. One hostel is good, but it is outside of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The best place if you want to go to a college with a lot of facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have a top-class library, so accommodating and comfortable. The facilities are a 4/5 since there's more construction happening. The hostel medical facilities are great, and so is sports; we have one event happen every year. Most of the events are hosted by the clubs. It's very enjoyable and fun.

Candidates who meet the minimum eligibility go to the official website and fill the application form. Further, the admission criteria for AAFT courses are entrance-based. The institute conducts its entrance exam and a personal interview round to shortlist candidates for admission. Find below the steps to complete theAAFT admission process:
1: AAFT Application Process

Interested students can visit the official website of the academy and fill out the application form available on the site. Once the form is duly filled in, candidates may submit the application form along with a nominal booking amount.
2:AAFT Selection Rounds

Admission to the institute is entrance-based. Students need to appear for an online test followed by a PI round. The institute will shortlist the students based on their performance in the selection rounds.
3: AAFT Admission Confirmation

The shortlisted candidates will have to pay the admission fee to accept the admission offer. Students need to submit the original copies of the documents required for the document verification process.

hostel.description: Separate hostel accommodation is available for outstation candidates within 8 km of AAFT campus on first co me first serve basis. The hostel rooms have air conditioners for summers and water geysers for use in winters (only) as well as the essential furniture including single beds, bed mattress, study tables, chairs, and cupboards, enabling comfortable stay and to ensure a learning conducive environment. Hygiene and cleanliness of the rooms, floors, laundry, and surroundings are taken care of by routine house-keeping services. Moreover, all rooms are networked and students are connected through a 24-hour Wi-Fi connection. Daily breakfast and dinner (lunch on declared institutional holidays) will be provided. The institute provides pick up and drop facilities to the resident students of the hostel. The transport timings pick up and departure from Campus are fixed and announced at the beginning of each academic year.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure and facilities are literally very amazing.
reviews.review_text: The facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and libraries are very great in our college. Everything is good in my opinion. Our college has a well-developed infrastructure that supports quality education. The hostel facilities are clean, safe, and comfortable for students.

reviews.review_heading: Work in progress, need time to improve.
reviews.review_text: The course is good. But I think more important topics should be taught. And for the hostel I don't stay in a hostel. So I don't have any comment on this matter. Wi-Fi is good, and facilities are perfect accordingly. The library is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the Data Science course is well-maintained and student-friendly. Classrooms are spacious, air-conditioned, and equipped with smart boards.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. Staff is supportive. Regular cultural events also happen.
reviews.review_text: I have no idea regarding the hostel, but my college has some specialties in the field of Photography, Art galleries, and Media. The college has a canteen, but I have never seen any sports facilities in my college. They have expertise in Photography, Media, and the Arts. Labs are better for learning day-to-day activities.

reviews.review_heading: Industry-focused learning with strong faculty and growing placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Course infrastructure is well developed. Computer labs are having updated systems and the required software for practical work. Reliable campus-wide Wi-Fi and a well stocked library. It supports both academic learning and research activities. Overall, facilities support hands-on learning, projects, and skill development.

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure, Supportive Faculty & Positive Learning Environment.
reviews.review_text: The college has overall good infrastructure. Most of the equipment required for practical learning is available and well-maintained. The library facilities are also very good and provide a supportive environment for study. Although we sometimes face minor issues with the projector or air conditioning in the classroom, these are occasional and manageable. Apart from that, the overall infrastructure and facilities are satisfactory and helpful for students.

reviews.review_heading: Love to be shared and happy with the college.
reviews.review_text: The department offers excellent facilities and good infrastructure. There is high-speed Wi-Fi all across the department, enabling easy access to online academic resources and a virtual learning platform. The quality of the hostel, the food in the mess, and the medical care are good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, but the only problem is the infrastructure of Sector 15.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are all nice, but the infrastructure is not that good, it becomes a bit congested and suffocated in college. There are very few rooms offered to students for their work. The canteen is good, but very small to gather. No, such sports and games happen occasionally.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are really good and helpful. Student Wi-Fi is provided, which is available to every student. Staff Wi-Fi is different. The library is also nice because it is open till 4:00 PM and you can sit and study in peace. Classrooms are nice. The hostel is available.

reviews.review_heading: Work in progress, need time to improve.
reviews.review_text: I am in the Sec-5 Noida campus. The labs are good. Not using the hostel facilities, the food and canteen food are amazing, but I wish the canteen had working AC or at least fans. The washrooms need big-time repair work. As the seat cover (the seat to sit) does not match the rim size, which is smaller, your skin touches it, which is very hygienic and could cause infection. The housekeeping does not wipe or clean after every use and does not have toilets rolls. I have to leave the campus to use th...

reviews.review_heading: It is highly recommended with a supportive environment. It strongly focuses on students' success.
reviews.review_text: The campus boasts excellent specialised infrastructure, including modern editing suites, a full-flagged chroma studio, and a well-stocked library. It is all supported by strong Wi-Fi connectivity in the hostel. Generally, it offers a shared room and basic medical support. The mess provides standard food, and the campus is very small.

reviews.review_heading: AAFT Noida offers great facilities, supportive faculty, and a positive learning environment.
reviews.review_text: Campus ensures student well-being with reliable medical support and active sports and game amenities. It receives excellent reviews for its infrastructure, learning environment, and industry focus. AAFT Noida offers very good facilities. It includes well-equipped labs, modern classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and a rich library. It supports creative and academic learning. The campus canteen provides good-quality food, and medical support is always available when needed. Students also have access to variou...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members, good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provided are very good. We have access to well-equipped classes which includes theory classrooms, sewing labs, CAD labs, textile labs, and many other classes and labs for specific work. Canteen food is decent. Basic medical help is available on campus with proper hygiene. We are provided with full access to all labs. The library has classes under proper guidance.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with all the studies done in college, educated, helpful, and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms, studio, labs, and the exception area give a very modern vibe. The facilities are very good, and according to me, almost everything is available in the college, like there is a separate lab for photography, there is a very modern library, and the food in the canteen is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, infrastructure is good, the only problem is Wi-Fi.
reviews.review_text: I don’t know about the hostel case; I don’t stay there, but the infrastructure of the department is good. The library also has space. The main problem is Wi-Fi. There is no Wi-Fi for students, and there is also no network connection, so we can’t even use our phones’ data.

review_content.Placements: The placements are pretty decent for computer and IT branch. But for EXTC and other branches it is very hard for them to be placed. If you are from computer and IT, you can expect a package of 9-10 LPA, if you perform well and have the skills. Many companies that are in Fintech come to hire. But the placement percentage is decreasing year by year, don't know if it is due to recession or not.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. It is one of the biggest campus in Mumbai and the campus has everything that is needed. The sports and extracurricular activities are too good here. The hostel is good too. It has all the facilities and it is pretty decent. The Spandan and Maitreiy hostels are the best. The food offered in them and the services given are good. The Polytechnic hostels arena isnt that good enough but their fees is less too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of K J Somaiya College of Engineering, Mumbai.

content.Placements: Btech placements are good, with 10 LPA for Btech, 13 LPA for computers, and 11 LPA for IT. The top roles offered were SDE, with the lowest package being 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies were JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, and Edelweiss. A compulsory internship is there in the college.
content.Infrastructure: All types, except single sharing, all other options are there in the hostel. WiFi is quite slow, food is good, only vegetarian and Jain options are there, as college follows Gandhian rules and regulations, medical facilities are absent , sports and games in campus is good and they are of Olympic level with proper equipment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: KJ Somaiya College for Engineering is worth it.

content.Placements: About 80-90% of the students who sit for placements get placed in college. The highest salary package offered last year was 51.02 LPA by Microsoft. The average salary package offered is around 7 LPA. Top companies like JP Morgan, Barclays, etc., visit the campus for recruitment. There are a lot of companies that provide internships. Roles offered are software developer and data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, multiple computer labs, and a huge library. It is a very nice well-maintained campus. It has got an athletic ground which carries all sports throughout the year. We have a big cricket/ football ground. Hostel has a basketball court.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the placements this year, good campus and hostels, good exposure .

content.Placements: The placements are pretty decent for computer and IT branch. But for EXTC and other branches it is very hard for them to be placed. If you are from computer and IT, you can expect a package of 9-10 LPA, if you perform well and have the skills. Many companies that are in Fintech come to hire. But the placement percentage is decreasing year by year, don't know if it is due to recession or not.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. It is one of the biggest campus in Mumbai and the campus has everything that is needed. The sports and extracurricular activities are too good here. The hostel is good too. It has all the facilities and it is pretty decent. The Spandan and Maitreiy hostels are the best. The food offered in them and the services given are good. The Polytechnic hostels arena isnt that good enough but their fees is less too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of K J Somaiya College of Engineering.

content.Placements: The highest package was 58 LPA, the average was 9 LPA, and the lowest was 7 LPA on average. Companies like Incred, J.P. Morgan, Land, Siemens, etc. are the top recruiters. 80 percent of students got internships during our year. Skills matter for getting a good placement and college helps you with the same.
content.Infrastructure: The course and faculty are nice in our department and the hostel is very near the college. The same goes for the mess; it is very good compared to other colleges. Classrooms have AC and projectors for better study, Wi-Fi is accessible all over the campus, the library is available in our college up until 6 p.m., and each and every book is present out there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Worthless in terms of ROI.

content.Placements: Most of the students from electronics and telecommunication engineering department were placed with average or above average package. The highest salary offered can go upto 58 LPA while average package is 10 LPA. Companies coming for placements vary from year to year.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is available in campus. Labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are AC facilitated. Library has moderate to good facilities. Food is quite good in canteen as well as in mess. Medical facilities are also provided in campus especially in case of emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Review of K J Somaiya College of Engineering, Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: All types, except single sharing, all other options are there in the hostel. WiFi is quite slow, food is good, only vegetarian and Jain options are there, as college follows Gandhian rules and regulations, medical facilities are absent , sports and games in campus is good and they are of Olympic level with proper equipment.

reviews.review_heading: KJ Somaiya College for Engineering is worth it.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, multiple computer labs, and a huge library. It is a very nice well-maintained campus. It has got an athletic ground which carries all sports throughout the year. We have a big cricket/ football ground. Hostel has a basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the placements this year, good campus and hostels, good exposure .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. It is one of the biggest campus in Mumbai and the campus has everything that is needed. The sports and extracurricular activities are too good here. The hostel is good too. It has all the facilities and it is pretty decent. The Spandan and Maitreiy hostels are the best. The food offered in them and the services given are good. The Polytechnic hostels arena isnt that good enough but their fees is less too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of K J Somaiya College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The course and faculty are nice in our department and the hostel is very near the college. The same goes for the mess; it is very good compared to other colleges. Classrooms have AC and projectors for better study, Wi-Fi is accessible all over the campus, the library is available in our college up until 6 p.m., and each and every book is present out there.

reviews.review_heading: Worthless in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available in campus. Labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are AC facilitated. Library has moderate to good facilities. Food is quite good in canteen as well as in mess. Medical facilities are also provided in campus especially in case of emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Honest Somaiya College Review.
reviews.review_text: Every classroom and lab has AC installed, with Wi-Fi accessibility all over the campus and a reading room facility also available. The polytechnic hostel is good; there are 4 students in each room with a separate table, cupboard, and attached and common bathrooms and washrooms. There is good hygiene and the food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KJ Somaiya College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is very top-notch at my college. 
There is a very huge campus in Mumbai, which is quite rare to find. It's a whole 80-acre campus in Ghatkopar, Mumbai. And there are 4 to 5 different colleges on campus like for engineering, MBA diploma, junior college, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a big campus and very good faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because of its faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college has labs, classrooms, etc. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. It has a good speed. The food served in the canteen is good. They provide medical facilities in emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with a huge campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is so huge one might forget the way inside the college. They provide with a lot of facilities like library, reading room, gym, but the only drawback is no AC in classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the faculty, internship, infrastructure and facilities etc.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good. Wi-fi and labs are good. We can use the most number of books in the library. The campus is big and it's one of the best campuses in Mumbai. If you looking for a campus then it's too good. The quality of the canteen is good. It is affordable and we have 3 canteens. Students can access medical facilities for free.

reviews.review_heading: A great College that can be considered just after top government colleges.

The college has a very vibrant campus with various activities, workshop or sessions coming up every now and then. I'm not a hosteller but this what I have seen and heard from my hosteller friends. They mess and canteen food is gre...

reviews.review_text: The fee is high but the infrastructure is not good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the quality of education and personal development provided in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: For degree join, else no.

content.Placements: Not sure about the highest and the lowest, but very less percent of placement. Internship level is medium, no skills, not practical knowledge, only practical files. Attendance mass recruiters like Infosys take students, but with very low package. No future for Cyber Security here.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is fairly good with VPN, labs are medium, classes are below average, and the library is average. The hostel is good, but food is below average and the canteen is the worst. Medical facilities are free and average, and sports are limited but okay. Other activities and events are enjoyable. Overall, the infrastructure is acceptable but has room for improvement.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It’s a good college, food is not bad, placement is above average, campus life is great.

content.Placements: The highest package is ₹1.1 CPA for CSE. The average package is ₹5–6 LPA. Around 70–80% of students got placed. It’s a good college, and placement is also above average. Courses available here are BE CSE, Nursing, and Pharmacy, which are high-tech and informative.
content.Infrastructure: Classes are good and airy. Labs are spacious. Food is okay, not bad. Hostel facilities are fulfilled generally. Sometimes, some issues occur which are resolved by the respective warden and hostel staff. Infrastructure of classrooms is also good. Labs are according to modern concepts.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Not recommended, you only come if it's the last option.

content.Placements: 60-70% of students get placed. The highest package is 40 LPA, lowest package is 4 LPA, and average is 7 LPA. Recruiting companies are Infosys and others. I am not sure about internships. From 3rd year only average companies come for the placement, and Google has already blacklisted this college. Roles offered in call center that are mostly non-tech roles.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi doesn't work without wrap. Labs are always under construction. Library is great but the timings are not suitable. All people in the hostel are double faced especially the warden they don't even listen to the parents. If there is any kind of medical emergency, they only say you would have told us before this and that.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent placements, supportive faculty, and modern campus facilities.

content.Placements: For the 2024 batch at Chitkara University, Himachal Pradesh, around 98% of students were placed. The highest package is 1.11 crore, the average is 8.5 Lacs, and the lowest is 4 LPA. Top recruiters included Infosys, TCS, Wipro, IBM, and Accenture, with roles in software, data analysis, business analysis, and digital marketing. About 70% of students secured internships with companies like LG Soft, Cognizant, and Deloitte.
content.Infrastructure: The course at Chitkara University offers modern facilities, including Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a comprehensive library. Hostels are comfortable, with good food in the mess and canteen. Medical services, sports, and recreational facilities are well-maintained for students’ overall well-being.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Not worth it; you can get a better college.

content.Placements: The placement cell is not very active, and only a few companies visit during placement drives, mostly offering low packages. Students are often left to find jobs on their own. Internship opportunities are also limited and not well-organized by the college. Though the campus is decent, and there are occasional cultural fests and activities, these do little to compensate for the academic shortcomings. Hostels are average at best, especially when it comes to handling student grievances. Simple tasks like getting documents signed or issues with fee payments become unnecessarily long processes, with hygiene and food quality being constant concerns.

college_info.intro:
Punjab University offers various Certificate, Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD programmes in multiple streams such as Business and Management Studies, Accounting and Commerce, Arts (Fine/ Visual/ Performing), Design, Engineering, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law, Medicine, and Health Sciences, and Science, and so on. PUCHD eligibility varies from course to course. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria to be able to apply for the course. Punjab University's flagship courses are MBA, BTech, BSc, and BA.
Punjab University offers these courses in full-time mode for the duration of 2 to 5 years. PUCHD fee structure includes tuition fees ranging from INR 480 to INR 6.19 Lakh. Punjab admissions to any of the course is based on merit and entrance exam. Therefore, candidates must secure the suggested minimum aggregate in Class 12 and graduation. Apart from this, candidates must secure valid score in accepted entrance exams such as JEE Main, CAT, MAT, XAT, PU MET, JAC Chandigarh etc. Considering the ROI, Panjab University UIET recorded the placement stats with the highest package of INR 42 LPA. For more details, candidates must visit the official website.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Please don't consider this.

content.Placements: If you’re coming to this college, then please don’t expect placement. Its the least possible thing college is concerned about. Almost every student here is either for Masters or has a family business, here for just a degree. Barely any student gets placed.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are just natural saunas. Just walk 5 minutes you’ll complete the campus tour. The labs and library are decent. Sports facilities are barely accessible. Never saw a medical facility here, so don’t know. Hostels are really small but decent. Don’t get food from that canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is top-notch choice if you want a balance of everything in life.

content.Placements: 89 percent of students were placed. The highest on-campus package is 21 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ZS and Infosys. 80 percent got internships. Top roles were SDE and analyst. There were well-recognized companies that visited our campus, and the placements were fine.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well maintained, with a few having AC. Hostels are top-notch with all facilities and no restrictions. Hostel staff is also very good. The hostels are well maintained. There are too many hostels, and students have the choice to choose according to their needs.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A practical and student-friendly college.

content.Placements: The placements for the B.Com batch were decent, and the requirements were good communication skills with basic domain knowledge. Around 25% of the batch sat for the placements, and most of them got placed. The highest package offered was around 4 LPA, whereas the average was around 2.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college has very good infrastructure and is one of the bigger colleges under Panjab University. The classrooms are big and have blackboards as well as smartboards for good audio-visual aids. There is also a library that has a wide range of books available. Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls with decent facilities. Medical facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Political Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college and students are too good. The environment of the college is positive.

content.Placements: The college provides many opportunities to improve our skills and potential. Many companies come to our college for placements of students. There are many opportunities in our college. Faculty members give knowledge about placements.
content.Infrastructure: There are 3 computer labs in the college. It provides a good network connection. The mess in the hostel is okay. The canteen provides food at an affordable price. It has Nescafé, Verka, and juice corners in the college for students and teachers. There are sports rooms with different games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college feels average to me.

content.Placements: I am studying B.Sc. Chemistry. There are 24 students in the department. It is a government college, so most students receive financial support through scholarships. Company placements are not discussed. IMAT is the final stage of the course, so internships are conducted during this period. The top roles offered include food safety department roles, forensic science, chemist positions, etc.
content.Infrastructure: As I am studying B.Sc. Chemistry, we need labs, which are only about 50% okay, with limited equipment. Wi-Fi is available only on the ground floor. The classrooms are spacious, but the library is poor, as it is usually closed even though it is a single room. Food availability is good. Currently, there is no hostel facility, and medical facilities are poor. Sports and games are also not very engaged in our college.

faqs.answer: Panjab Univeresity MBA admissions are entirely entrance-based. For admission to MBA course at UBS and UIAMS, candidates must have a valid score of either CAT or  PU MET exams, respectively. placement_data.title: Panjab University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: Punjab University has released the placement details for its constituent colleges - University Institute of Engineering and Technology and University Business School. The highest and average packages offered to the Engineering batch 2025 was INR 24 LPA and INR 8.51 LPA , respectively. More than 100 companies took part in the placement drive. There were 356 job offers made during the Punjab University UIET placements 2025. The students of the MBA batch 2025 secured the highest package of INR 24 LPA and the average pacage of INR 12.43 LPA in 2025.

Earlier, as per the media reports, the highest and average package offered during Panjab University MBA placements 2023 was INR 58.48 LPA and INR 13.7 LPA , respectively. The MBA placement rate recorded during Panjab University placements 2023 was 91.3%.

faqs.question: How are Panjab University MBA placements?
faqs.answer: Punjab University offers decent placements annually to its MBA graduates. In 2025, the highest and average packages offered to the MBA batch 2025 was INR 24 LPA and INR 12.43 LPA, respectively. The median package offered was INR 12 LPA.

faqs.question: How expensive is MBA at Panjab University?
faqs.answer: The total fee for MBA ranges between INR 42,700 and INR 6.20 lakh. This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. For more details and fee break-up for MBA at PU, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of Panjab University or the MBA-affiliated college of PU. Other than the course fee, students are required to pay the registration fee for CAT or PU MET exam depending on their admission process The application fee is INR 3,250 at UBS and INR 2,175 (PU MET) for General category candidates.

faqs.question: What is the MBA application fee of PUCHD?
faqs.answer: The application fee for MBA at Panjab University Chandigarh is INR 2,710 for General category candidates. Panjab University offers two-year MBA programmes across four specialisations via the University Business School and across seven specialisations via the University Institute of Applied Management Sciences . Other than these, Dr. S. Bhatnagar University Institute of Chemical Engineering and Technology offers an Integrated BE (Chemical) - MBA to the students. For the application fee of UIAMS and Dr. SS Bhatnagar, candidates can refer to their official websites.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Animation Designing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is best but students are not coming to college and faculty members are honest.

content.Placements: The percentage of placements in college is around 70%. In 3rd year, we will get the internships. The roles offered in my course are animator and much more. The placement percentage is average in college. Many companies visit our college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: There is no college hostel. Classrooms are okay and library is very small. Wi-Fi is also good but there is no backup for college when the electricity is gone.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are great. They are qualified and very helpful. Semester exams are difficult in college. The degree of the college is from Himalaya University. Faculty members are very honest and best. Faculty members are best and much better than others.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Interior Designing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good College with below average management.

content.Placements: The college does help you provide where the openings are available, but they do not conduct special interviews. The college creates placement groups where they post the vacancies available at firms and their names. The links are not foolproof, but yes, students have to suffer.
content.Infrastructure: No hostel available, it is just one floor with multiple classes with average Wi-Fi quality, no library. The Wi-Fi works sometimes, sometimes it doesn't. The classrooms are well-maintained and cleaned every day. No mess available but has a famous food park near.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Interior Design - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College has good infrastructure and faculty for the students of the interior design course.

content.Placements: In our college, 40-50% of the students get placements in this course. The average package offered at this college for the students was between 3-5 LPA. The college has a highly active and developed placement cell. Top recruiters at our college were MRF, Acotech, Sila, Navi, etc. for this course. Top roles offered were interior designer, product designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good-quality facilities and infrastructure for the students of the interior designing courses. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, classrooms, sports, seminar, hostel, medical, etc. facilities were available for the students. The mess and canteen food at our college was good to eat. Hostel rooms were furnished and fully maintained.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Designing - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The best experience in Pune.

content.Placements: My overall experience is really good. All the staff members in the college are very friendly. There is no partiality in any field. I was the miss fresher of 2020. They use to take us to fashion exhibitions. They also have fashion weeks for us. I participated in the Pune Times Fashion Week. It was a great experience and I am thankful that I was a part of it.
content.Infrastructure: The college didn't have a hostel, but they use to recommend some good hostels. And the hostel they recommend was pretty good and clean, but the owner of the hostel was really bad. The food was really good the best part was hygiene.

CEPT University boys hostel consists of two blocks and offers facilities like a daily newspaper, telephone, common room with T.V, gym and a common canteen.
Apart from that it also provides facilities like:
'Paying Guest Housing Mela' which is organized by students where PG housing providers will present housing options within close proximity to CEPT University.
'Initial Home Stay Service' where a student will stay with the family of a current CEPT student/ faculty member/ staff or alumni for one week during which (s)he may find an accommodation for himself/ herself.

Lilavati Lalbhai library is top-notch, with amazing in-house and out-house productions. Canteens could sure do with certain updates. A new set of hostels is being constructed and should begin functioning in the second half of 2025. The holder group of hostels and the mess are s...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best university for Masters in Housing Design Course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are first-rate. The library provides free Wi-Fi and a vast assortment of books on a variety of subjects. There are additional places with Wi-Fi connectivity. The campus has a number of dining options. A hospital is also located on site. Most of the hostels contain a courtyard, a stadium, and five grounds where students can play sports including hockey, cricket, and soccer.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best university for a master's in urban planning course.
reviews.review_text: The college has a wonderful system-based design and wonderful unconventional school classrooms. We have studios where we play nonstop music over loudspeakers, host parties, and have open conversations with teachers. Wi-Fi is available. The library is located on the 4th floor. Medical services are provided, and the hostel chaos is minimal.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the best university for a bachelor's in architecture (B.Arch) course.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best university for a Master's in Urban Design course.

There are so many books to choose from, and everything is included. The hostels are within walking distance of the campus, and students often choose hostels over rented apartments.

reviews.review_heading: Student at CEPT University.
reviews.review_text: Our college supports various courses in different disciplines. The overall infrastructure of our college is really good. We are served with hygienic and tasty food. There are certain restrictions on the movement of students in and out of the campus. Also, all the medical facilities are available within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: My masters in CEPT University.
reviews.review_text: The laboratories are well maintained with maximum number of systems. Air conditioned classrooms with smart classes and projectors. As there is a open auditorium present at the centre of our college. There is a big spacious library present within our college.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at CEPT University.
reviews.review_text: The university campus is located over 12 acres of land and is well-equipped with all basic amenities, such as IT services, smart classrooms, labs, a cafeteria, a library, a hall, a conference hall, an auditorium, Wi-Fi, etc. The college has a good infrastructure. The University has hostel facilities for both girls and boys. The University ...

All the necessary facilities were available for the students in the college campus. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, classrooms, halls, sports complex, hostel, medical etc. Facilities were available for the college students.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure of the college is so beautiful.
reviews.review_text: There are various types of games available for the students to play on the campus. Games like basketball, Volleyball, Football, Badminton, etc. Are available for the students to play on the campus. There is a Wi-Fi facility available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Conservation Course at CEPT.
reviews.review_text: The University is known for its infrastructure by renowned architect BV Doshi and does live up to its name. Also, the university caters to most student needs such as on-campus Wi-Fi, an outstanding library and also 2 canteens that work till 9 pm. The campus has an inhouse print shop, stationary, and full-fledged laboratory and is open for 24 hours during jury week.

reviews.review_heading: Reasons to take transport at CEPT.

The library is also spacious and has a large collection of books from various disciplines. There is also a facility for students to study individually or work in groups. The library is open until midnight. The hostel facilities need to be upgraded.

reviews.review_heading: A programme that equips you to change the world.

There is a plethora of reading material to choose from, and the accessibility is all-inclusive. The hostels are walking distance from the campus, and the students often choose hostels over rented flats.
